youtube_description:
A V-taper is just two things: wide shoulders and a small waist.

Raise the dumbbells out to your sides up to shoulder height, then lower them slowly. Go lighter than you think.

For the vacuum, breathe all the way out, pull your belly button in towards your spine, and then hold it for 20 seconds.

Do side laterals on every upper body day. Do vacuums every morning.
